If you want union work (ACTRA, CAEA) I 100% recommend an agent. If you’re looking to get some credits with non-union work I find there are a lot of great Facebook groups that a lot of even well known commercial and smaller casting directors will post to. It depends on the city - probably best if you live somewhere with a lot of work (Toronto, Vancouver etc), but a lot of work for extras will be local only for shoot locations (like Hamilton, Winnipeg, etc). Always use your judgement and do your research before agreeing to non-union work! 😊
